title: Add canonical task grouping metadata contract
description: Add optional issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature fields to core task/create/update/batch types with omitempty JSON behavior. Treat featureId as a stable grouping key and feature as its human-readable name. Define reusable typed grouping-filter normalization and case-insensitive exact AND matching while preserving stored casing. Keep legacy files valid and add core serialization/compatibility tests.
